scope: All 22 practical prompts and original integral blank spaces. The official distribution file has no filled answer sheet or official marking supplement.

translation.font: Embedded matching Noto Serif KR and Noto Sans KR, including the matching italic style. Native scientific Latin and numerical glyphs preserve their source faces, including the charge exponent, and original equipment labels remain attached. One source Cambria program served a blank space only and was pruned on save.

qa.pixel_mask_note: The selected source and target text bounds include a 2.05 pt horizontal and 1.5 pt vertical margin for italic and outline overhang. The original tight mask reported 53 pixels, all white-to-ink in the Korean glyph extrema on pages 1 and 8.
